metadataExportTab.heading: Metadata Export
metadataExportTab.intro: Publish this organization's governed metadata — tables, columns, domains, stewards, approved relationships and column-level lineage — to an external data catalog. Publication is outbound only: Provisa never reads the target catalog back as a source of truth.
metadataExportTab.notEntitled: Metadata export requires the {{tier}} plan. Upgrade to configure a catalog target.
metadataExportTab.enabled: Publish metadata to an external catalog
metadataExportTab.secretHelp: Stored credentials are never displayed. Leave blank to keep the current one; clear and save to remove it.
metadataExportTab.reconcileCronHelp: Cron expression for the full-snapshot reconcile that corrects drift. Leave empty to publish on change only.
metadataExportTab.healthOk: The target catalog accepted the connection.
